summary: Three of six seats returned schema-valid reviews of plan r3 (claude, codex, glm), each asking for revision; gemini and kimi returned malformed output and qwen exited nonzero, so none of them contributes an opinion. Two groups are rated high: GO3-C1 citing a preview that r3 removed, and GO5 lacking evidence of what was actually applied. Ten concerns have one supporter each; most attack text the r3 repairs created.

agreed_concerns.title: GO3-C1 starts from a GO2-C1 preview that r3 no longer writes
agreed_concerns.summary: r3 made GO2-C1 write an outcome report and no preview; GO3-C1 and C3 still start from "the GO2-C1 preview", and the report need not carry the before model needed to replay the admitted operations.

agreed_concerns.title: GO5 cannot tell elements applied from elements previewed
agreed_concerns.summary: A proposal and its preview exist whether or not the preview was applied, so "elements added" is unestablished; a narrowed round has two proposals.

prioritized_fixes.title: GO3-C1 starts from a GO2-C1 preview that r3 no longer writes
prioritized_fixes.action: GO3-C1 starts from the GO2-C1 outcome report; the outcome report carries the before model as the preview does (text and sha256); GO3-C3 uses a second fixture with an admitted preview that has policy refusals.

prioritized_fixes.title: GO5 cannot tell elements applied from elements previewed
prioritized_fixes.action: The evolution record, or its absence, is a GO5 input and the only source of elements added; a narrowed round reads the applied proposal; add applied-vs-unapplied and narrowed-then-applied criteria.

prioritized_fixes.title: go2-outcomes-apply-replay
prioritized_fixes.action: GO2: name the outcomes switch and make apply replay it from the reviewed preview, as shape_report is replayed (cli_service.py:810); add a criterion that a preview with outcomes applies and an edited one is refused.

prioritized_fixes.title: go2-admitted-unreached-gates
prioritized_fixes.action: GO2: in an outcome report, operations that a later gate never reached are unassessed with the gates named, not admitted.

prioritized_fixes.title: go3-origin-no-home
prioritized_fixes.action: GO3: the origin id is an optional proposal field under R0.3, models.py joins GO3 homes, and a proposal without it keeps its bytes.

prioritized_fixes.title: go1-shared-doc-control-coverage
prioritized_fixes.action: GO1: a verify mode of parse_scope compares snapshots at scope close and is switched on for the whole GO1 lane; name loaded Models as holders of nested references.

prioritized_fixes.title: d6-forced-by-order
prioritized_fixes.action: D6 is forced: GO1 merges by its own pull request; state it in section 3 as binding.

prioritized_fixes.title: go5-c1-not-discriminating
prioritized_fixes.action: GO5: a committed round with a known mix states each bucket count derived from the fixture.

prioritized_fixes.title: go1-c5-failure-consequence
prioritized_fixes.action: GO1: a failed C5 stops GO1 for a ruling before its pull request.

prioritized_fixes.title: go1-goal-json-two-parses
prioritized_fixes.action: GO1: goal reads once per text and reader; GO1-C1 adds .json counts.

prioritized_fixes.title: s7-ruff-red-stale
prioritized_fixes.action: Section 7: drop the stale ruff-red line.

prioritized_fixes.title: h21-vg2-unattended-growth-claim
prioritized_fixes.action: H21: under the ruled VG D2 (a) only VG5 changes unattended-growth.md; the start conditions stay as the coordinator set them.
